title: Folsom State Prison Entrance

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation sampled at the photographed entrance’s estimated position on the mapped transverse wall.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap mapped entrance node, short gate wall and adjacent prison site, interpreted with the exact approved public photographs.
mapIdentity.scope: Named prison site, mapped transverse entrance wall and approach cut, two exact public-domain Qualla photographs, and the original regional elevation.

note: At the end of the approach, a projecting granite gateway with a broad vehicle arch and narrow pedestrian arch sits below a corbelled tower with a glazed octagonal room and flared green roof. Granite returns extend on either side.
